market_scope: x402-list indexed services and monitored facilitators; not full ecosystem
caveats: Publisher's deduplicated listed-service settlement slice; not total x402 volume or AgentMine revenue.
The largest service's imported flow and 98.9% top-buyer-address concentration complicate organic-demand interpretation.
Buyer addresses are not unique persons, companies, customers or verified buyers.
30-day windows overlap with 2026-10-13; comparisons are differences in rolling publisher estimates, not period-on-period sales growth.
Publisher's measured-facilitator coverage percentage is not global ecosystem coverage.
Top-1 and top-10 percentages are rounded; effective-service and fee-tail arithmetic is conditional on those rounded inputs.
